# RigHand Copilot Instructions

- Always run `git push origin main` after every commit in this repository.
- Confirm the push result before reporting a task as complete. Distinguish between `Everything up-to-date` and output showing new commits were uploaded.
- After pushing, verify the intended GitHub repository, branch, and expected files/content are visible on `dallas8000-ops/Righand` `main`; do not rely only on local `git status`, `origin/main`, or a clean worktree.
